why: A published price of zero. Zero and "not published" are different findings that a careless type collapses into one, and this subject is the reason PricingExtraction distinguishes Some(0.0) from None. A free tier is a competitive fact — often the most important one on the page — and reporting it as "no pricing found" loses it.
source:
Plans

Free — $0 per month, forever. One grower, up to ten orders a month, and a single delivery route. No card required to start, and we do not ask for one until you outgrow it.

Market — $39 per month. Up to three growers and three routes.

Regional — $199 per month. Unlimited growers and multi-region routing.

The free plan is not a trial. It does not expire, and accounts that stay inside its limits are never charged.
